engine: PGlite/PostgreSQL, isolated fixture; live ops_member definition
tests: Creation requires valid email, known role, adult attestation and explicit access approval
Lost-response retries preserve one invitation; changed payload and duplicate pending admin invite rejected
Invitation list does not expose raw tokens or hashes
Wrong email, unrelated tenant and ordinary accounts cannot read or grant leadership
Unverified email, known minor, shared login and anonymous access denied
Administrator reviews and accepts once without any team membership
Accepted-token replay never restores removed access; pending revocation is distinct from access removal
Final organization administrator cannot be removed
Scoped position acceptance enables actual organization membership predicate, preserves scope and records history without team/admin rows
A limited leader cannot invite or promote administrators
Clearing a position removes its access and accepted link cannot reassign it
Changed position revision and governance permissions invalidate outstanding invitation
Athlete representative posts and cross-organization positions cannot be invited
Revocation is idempotent and expired/revoked links grant nothing
Removing an inviter also revokes their outstanding invitations
Email context fixes recipient, verifies saved token and administrator, and limits duplicate requests
Raw invitation storage and anonymous RPC execution are blocked
Only token hashes persist; no secrets in audit and no affiliate/team mutations
